claim: A verification is revoked by an incompatible core or detector revision and by contradiction, regardless of time. Time alone only makes it stale, and a stale verification is revalidated rather than discarded. An evidence record is immutable.

cases.name: a verification records what it was issued against
cases.expectation: ROM, core, detector and profile revision

cases.name: detector revision changed
cases.expectation: REVOKED immediately, however fresh the verification is
cases.observed: REVOKED: detector revision changed: verified against det-1, now det-2

cases.name: and it stays revoked
cases.expectation: REVOKED with its cause, not downgraded to NONE

cases.name: core revision changed
cases.observed: REVOKED: core revision changed: verified against core-1, now core-2

cases.name: revalidating a revoked verification
cases.observed: revalidated false, state REVOKED - a REVOKED verification cannot be revalidated

cases.name: contradiction
cases.expectation: REVOKED regardless of time, with the reason kept
cases.observed: REVOKED by contradiction: the game outcome disagreed with RAM

cases.name: a goal that was never verified
cases.expectation: NONE, not REVOKED and not VALID

cases.name: mutating an evidence record
cases.expectation: throws, and the stored record is unchanged
cases.observed: Cannot assign to read only property 'outcome' of object '#<Object>'; stored outcome still confirmed

cases.name: mutating a record provenance list
cases.observed: Cannot add property 1, object is not extensible

cases.name: a registry built without a detector revision
cases.expectation: still verifies, and a detector revision cannot revoke what was never recorded

totals.note: time alone never revoked a verification in any case above
